g.text: 200 + the orders created by that first request
read cart items + current prices / vendors
create ONE Order (vendor set, status PENDING_PAYMENT)
201 Created + list of orders (one per vendor)
create DeliveryBooking (status BOOKED) linked to Transaction
read orders WHERE vendor = me AND status = CONFIRMED
create Payment (provider CASH, status VERIFIED, amount = total)
Order.status is NOT changed - cash is a payment event, not a lifecycle step
validate order.status in CONFIRMED | PREPARING | READY_FOR_PICKUP
validate fulfillment = DELIVERY and status in CONFIRMED | PREPARING
Vendor POS flows are vendor-scoped: a vendor can only act on
orders they fulfill (catalog.Vendor). Every guard reads
receipt_serial lives on vendors.VendorTransaction, not on Payment,
and is stable across reprints because receipt_attempt is stored.
Verify payment server-side. A redirect alone is not proof of payment.
Payment is idempotent through unique (provider, provider_reference),
and order creation is idempotent through the Idempotency-Key header,
so a double-submitted checkout cannot double-charge.
